describe.description: A low, quadrupedal creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. It has a broad, flat, pale pinkish-tan head with large round eyes and a blunt snout, with six feathery reddish external gills projecting from behind the head. Its ventral body, neck, limbs and tail underside are pale, moist-looking, and deeply wrinkled with transverse folds, while its entire dorsal surface from the neck to the base of the tail is covered in overlapping large brown scales. It stands on four short, thick, fleshy limbs with splayed clawed feet, and a long thick tapering tail extends to the left rear, scaly on top and fleshy below.

describe.description: A four-legged animal shown in right-side three-quarter view with a broad flat pale pinkish-tan amphibian-like head, a stout body, short thick limbs, and a long tail extending to the left beyond the image edge. The entire back and upper sides from behind the head onto the tail are covered in dense overlapping rounded brown scales, while the head, throat, belly, lower sides, legs and underside are naked pale pink wrinkled moist-looking skin with transverse folds. Behind the head on each side project three dark reddish feathery external gill stalks with fine filaments. The head has large round eyes, tiny nostrils, and a wide slightly upturned mouth. Each of the four feet is broad with five short toes tipped with small dark claws.
